changelog: Orion 3.3 — Money and maximum capability. Money runs through your API now: live bitcoin price with its source and time, watched PUBLIC addresses with balances, your money ledger with totals, and sell prep that shows the BTC amount, the fee estimate, and the net before anything moves — Orion prepares, your tap in your own app sells, and Orion never holds keys, seeds, or logins. Selling tools: listing drafts in Created Apps under Selling, price-checks with sources, buyer reply drafts. Calling: contacts, dialer, speakerphone, a Calls page with your recent calls and redial. Creating adds storefront and invoice makers, mastery-checked like everything else. Capability max: multi-step asks run as chains that save their place and resume where they stopped, your corrections update skills on the spot, 'learn how to' researches through your API first, and the new What Can You Do page lists only powers that just passed a live self-test — unproven powers are labeled unproven. Everything routes through your API first (built into Orion, then the server copy), and the proof line under answers says who served them.
